_note: Lists used by scripts/pii_scan.py. Every entry was written from memory on the checked date and is marked unverified until someone reads the primary source. The scanner prints a line saying so.

reserved_email_domains.source: IETF RFC 2606 and the IANA reserved domains list

reserved_email_tlds.unit: top-level names that never resolve on the public internet

public_mail_domains.unit: domains where anyone can hold a real mailbox
public_mail_domains.source: common public mail providers; not an official list

fictional_phone_prefixes.unit: leading digits of number ranges set aside for drama and examples (United Kingdom, Australia)
fictional_phone_prefixes.source: Ofcom numbers for use in TV and radio drama; ACMA numbers for use in fiction

nanp_fictional_line_range.unit: last four digits, with exchange 555, reserved for fictional use in North American numbers
nanp_fictional_line_range.source: North American Numbering Plan Administrator, 555 line number guidance

published_test_cards.unit: card numbers that payment providers publish for test mode
published_test_cards.source: payment providers' testing pages (Stripe, PayPal sandbox, Adyen)

ssn_never_issued.unit: United States social security number parts that are never assigned, plus numbers used in advertising
